subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw backfill signed macOS desktop assets and `appcast-beta.xml` for `v2026.5.22-beta.1`, or leave that old beta without desktop distribution and only fix future beta release gates?
rationale: The current docs permit beta releases without a macOS app, the requested publish path needs private release credentials, and the open candidate PR changes future release policy rather than merely repairing a file on main.

options.title: Do not backfill old beta
options.body: Document or comment that this beta train will remain without macOS desktop assets, then focus future signed-beta behavior through the linked candidate PR or a narrower replacement.

options.title: Backfill this beta
options.body: Run the private macOS validate/publish workflow for this exact tag and publish signed ZIP/DMG/dSYM assets plus a valid beta appcast entry.

options.title: Require beta desktop going forward
options.body: Land or replace the linked candidate PR for future beta gates, then cut a new beta with signed desktop assets instead of changing the old tag’s release state.

recommendation.title: Do not backfill old beta
recommendation.body: Document or comment that this beta train will remain without macOS desktop assets, then focus future signed-beta behavior through the linked candidate PR or a narrower replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: The appcast and release-doc history makes this the best available owner for the beta distribution policy decision.
